welcomeDescription: This boilerplate includes sample authentication, account, user, role, and service status modules. Adapt each module to your app.
welcomeImageAlt: A workspace dashboard summarizing accounts, users, and services
accountDescription: The account module covers profiles, password changes, and account deactivation. Adapt the flow to your app's policies.
accountImageAlt: An account profile with contact details and verification status
accessDescription: The sample modules cover user lists, account details, role hierarchy, and access restrictions. Adapt authorization rules in your backend.
accessImageAlt: Team roles and access permissions protected by a shield
statusDescription: The sample page checks the API and database. Adapt its endpoint and response format to your backend.
statusImageAlt: API and database health with active service status
